text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin has convinced herself that her sisters' dream is to dance. And she remains sure of that until the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sisters scold her for deciding their dreams for them, and insist that what they really want is for her to keep racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her coworkers feel the same, seeing their own dreams in her running. Ines's races touch people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to run in the Arima Kinen against such strong opponents as Oguri Cap and Mejiro Ryan, and with the dreams of her family—and everyone else—on her shoulders!
